layers.text: Recolour as a liquorice sweet town and change no shape: the round cake keep becomes a stack of layered sweets, bright white sugar and pink #ff8fc0 layers under a black liquorice top #23192b; the roofs of the little houses become black liquorice with a white stripe; the wall becomes black liquorice blocks topped with small lemon yellow #ffe04a and pink beads; the lollipop a pink and white swirl. Keep every shape, the size, outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
